sections.heading: MINOR IN MUSEUM AND CURATORIAL STUDIES
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Visual Arts

Completion of first-year requirements including 1.0 course either from Art History 1640 or two of Art History 1641A/B, Art History 1642A/B, Art History 1644A/B, Art History 1646A/B or Art History 1648A/B, with a minimum grade of 60% in each course.
0.5 course in Museum and Curatorial Studies at the 3600-level or above.
3.0 courses from: Museum and Curatorial Studies 2600-level or Art History 2600-level or above.
For modules that can and cannot be combined, please visit the Visual Arts Modular Checklist site https://www.uwo.ca/visarts/undergraduate/Modules.html
